**Finding submitted: deviation (fallback target) on § 15.16 Nonsolicitation (p0841).**

- **Only responsive clause:** searches for "solicit", "hire", "employ", "induce", "unsolicited" returned no other restrictive-covenant language, so § 15.16 is the sole non-solicit and it binds PB (mutual).
- **Already at fallback:** mutual ("neither Party"), scope limited to personnel involved in the performance or oversight of the development activities, solicitation-only (no no-hire), and a general-advertising carve-out.
- **Fails fallback on two terms:** duration is Term + an undisclosed `[***]` tail measured from expiry (not 12 months from the end of involvement), and there is no unsolicited-approach carve-out.
- **Redline (validated ok:true, minimality passed):** two surgical replacements — re-anchoring the restriction to "until twelve (12) months after an employee … ceases to be involved …" and appending "or to hire any employee who approaches a Party on an unsolicited basis" to the existing carve-out sentence. All other wording is preserved verbatim.
